title: Second-order Wasserstein response for Lévy laws
summary: Weak perturbations of the same size can lead to terminal Wasserstein errors of different orders. For infinitely divisible laws smoothed by a Gaussian, we differentiate their distribution functions with respect to variance-weighted Lévy characteristics. This includes distributional directions caused by moving atoms. We obtain first- and second-order expansions that are uniform over Lipschitz test functions.
